title: ChipBlocks flows manifest
description: Single source of truth for end-to-end build flow toolchains. Per ADR-005, this file is authored at repo root. Shuttles reference rows here via the `flow` field. Each flow row describes a chain of tools (Yosys + nextpnr + icepack for FPGA; OpenLane + Magic for ASIC) and points at the Python adapter that orchestrates the chain.

target_kind.description: What the flow produces. Determines which adapter contract method is called.

tools.description: Ordered list of tools the flow invokes.

install_check.description: Shell command that exits 0 if the toolchain is installed; non-zero otherwise. Used by build.py's pre-flight.

utilization_parser.description: Path to the Python module that parses tool output for resource utilization (LCs, BRAMs, area, etc.). Per-flow because every tool has its own log format.

adapter_path.description: Path to the Python adapter that orchestrates this flow. Today the iCE40 path lives inside build.py; new flows get their own backend/flows/<id>.py module.

pdk_compatible.description: List of PDK ids this flow works with. Empty / omitted for FPGA-bitstream flows (PDK doesn't apply).
